Cover Page for Bonterms Standard AI Addendum

By executing this Cover Page, Customer and Provider enter into the Bonterms Standard AI Addendum Version 2.0 (Cover Page Version) (available at https://bonterms.com/standard/ai-addendum-v2-cover-page-version) by this reference. A reference copy may be attached. The AI Addendum also includes the contents of this Cover Page, including the Key Terms and any Additional Terms. Capitalized terms not defined in this Cover Page have the meanings given in the AI Addendum.

Key Terms

Main Agreement This AI Addendum is incorporated into the agreement between Customer and Provider identified below: [Name/date of Main Agreement]

AI Addendum Effective Date [Fill in]

Additional Terms

The following additions to or modifications of the AI Addendum are agreed by the parties and control in the event of any conflicts:

Signatures

Agreed to as of the AI Addendum Effective Date by each party’s authorized representative:

Customer: Signature: Name and Title: Company: Date: Provider: Signature: Name and Title: Company: Date:
